claims.statement: Complete first-half E/M atlas and p-coloured pair fibres of size2*tau_div(h).
claims.nonclaim: This does not prove that a pair exists at every p.

claims.statement: Swap and original divisor complementation give a free Klein-four action on every actual target-pair set. In particular T_a is divisible by4.
claims.exceptions: Not true for an arbitrary nonnegative residue coefficient array.

claims.statement: For every prime p=1 mod4, p>=2^20, the complete sum of real principal-only lower bounds 2P_a-E_a is <=-p*log(p)/24.
claims.proof: Explicit divisor bound, odd-progression reciprocal-totient bound, and original diagonal mass.
claims.nonclaim: This is not an upper bound for the true ES count.

claims.statement: For arbitrary per-shell sets of at most J even characters, the real lower-bound sum is <=-p*log(p)/24 at p>=2^20*J^3. This includes all subgroup observations containing -1 of index<=J.
claims.exceptions: No assertion about zero-truncated bounds, unbounded index, or the balanced-integer refinement. Positive weights require the recorded upper/lower ratio.

claims.statement: Original coset masses and collision energy give T_a>=sum_C b_(|B|/2)(m_C)-E_a, with complete equality locus and multiple-of-four sharpening.
claims.exceptions: B is an observation subgroup, not assumed to be the actual stabilizer or saturated support. Positivity is not asserted at every p.

claims.statement: Original complementation gives c(g)=c(pa/g), even coefficients at g^2=pa, and the displayed exact labelled convex refinement.
claims.exceptions: The minimizing model is not identified with a newly available divisor source.

claims.statement: At prime87481 every first-half real principal bound and its basic integer refinement are nonpositive, although34 shells are occupied.
The principal-only test covers4515 of4519 hard primes<=2m and misses exactly87481,196561,944329,1915201.
claims.independent_check: All positive certificates, full divisor cap/candidate set, and every first-half shell at each miss.
claims.nonclaim: Not a new overall ES verification range.

claims.statement: The four stated original subgroup/integer certificates return ES states; at p944329,R63 the unsaturated cubic cosets8,8,0 have integer lower bound8 equal to T_a.
claims.nonclaim: These chosen examples do not prove a universal quotient-selection theorem.

claims.statement: For every prescribed hard prime, sum over the complete first-half source of T_a is positive.
claims.note: Neither principal exclusion, finite repair, graph expansion nor metric reconstruction is substituted for this statement.

claims.statement: At p=944329,a=236094,R=47, five of23 even-character modes and the actual collision energy certify T_a>=60, attained. Exact rational squared-norm bounds are (1009,1010) and(24,25).
claims.exceptions: No intermediate subgroup exists, but that is not an obstruction to proper Fourier projection. No universal mode-selection theorem.

claims.statement: For m>=3 define C_m by the finite prime/exponent formula (18b). If p>=2^20 and p^(m-2)>=(12*J*C_m^2)^m, every original full raw sum retaining at most J even modes per shell is <=-p*log(p)/8. C_4=9 gives threshold max(2^20,944784*J^2).
claims.exceptions: No assertion about zero-truncated sums, sparse shell selection, arbitrary weight ratios, integer balancing, or all possible spectral algorithms. This is not an upper bound on the actual ES count.
